hard_gates.reason: 384K/512K performance, memory/KV and stability are not yet first-party measured for this target configuration.
Correctness, repo understanding, patch minimality, regression avoidance and scope control are not yet measured.
Real search/edit/diff/build/test/repair loops are not yet benchmarked.
Long-session, restart, crash recovery and context-retention evidence is absent.
The final production topology must bind inference/workspace/build/test/repository/control placement before end-to-end fitness can be scored.

Split AI-node + development-host topology is architecturally plausible, but end-to-end coding task evidence is still required.

next_required_tests: Compare monolithic vs split execution placement
notes: Current 32K performance is strong evidence for an inference worker role, not enough to qualify the full high-intensity large-project coding production configuration.
